description: Defines the HttpBasicAuthOptionProvider class which extends PostAuthOptionProvider; it provides HTTP Basic Authentication options for OAuth2 token requests.

classes.name: HttpBasicAuthOptionProvider
classes.description: A class that adds HTTP Basic Authentication headers to OAuth2 token request options, extending PostAuthOptionProvider.

methods.name: getAccessTokenOptions
methods.description: Generates access token options including Basic Authentication headers using client ID and secret, ensuring required parameters are provided and encoding credentials in base64.
